$description: Boundary + BAML design tokens, v1.0.0, 2026-10-16. Owner: Happy Pizza Studio. Source of record: Boundary + BAML Brand Guide (brand-book.pdf), Color / Typography / Logo sections only. Where the book and the site code disagree, the book wins here; the site's own values are kept, clearly labeled, under `siteTheme`.

pasture.$description: Boundary's color. Ten-step scale, pale tint to near-black shade. Brand book p.4. Step names match the site's --color-pasture-* tokens (src-css/boundary-globals.css L61-69); the site publishes step 600 as --color-pasture rather than a numbered step.

clover.$description: BAML's color, evolved from the original BAML purple. Ten-step scale. Brand book p.4. Step names match the site's --color-clover-* tokens (src-css/boundary-globals.css L71-79); the site publishes step 200 as --color-clover rather than a numbered step.

50.$description: Book p.4 (R241 G233 B255). Site: --color-clover-50, boundary-globals.css L71.

100.$description: Book p.4 (R228 G209 B255). Site: --color-clover-100, boundary-globals.css L72.

200.$description: Core color, the outlined swatch on book p.4 (R202 G170 B242). Site: --color-clover, boundary-globals.css L70 and baml-globals.css L177; not published as a numbered step.

300.$description: Book p.4 (R180 G132 B234). Site: --color-clover-300, boundary-globals.css L73.

400.$description: Book p.4 (R154 G91 B218). Site: --color-clover-400, boundary-globals.css L74.

500.$description: Book p.4 (R131 G62 B193). Site: --color-clover-500, boundary-globals.css L75.

600.$description: Book p.4 (R109 G46 B163). Site: --color-clover-600, boundary-globals.css L76.

700.$description: Book p.4 (R85 G33 B130). Site: --color-clover-700, boundary-globals.css L77.

800.$description: Book p.4 (R62 G24 B95). Site: --color-clover-800, boundary-globals.css L78.

900.$description: Book p.4 (R38 G11 B61). Site: --color-clover-900, boundary-globals.css L79 and baml-globals.css L178.

core.$description: Alias. BAML's color: it leads every BAML layout, and reads like flowers in the pasture inside a Boundary layout. Book p.3-4.

black.$description: Book p.4 (R15 G15 B15). Sits at the base of both scales and is the default for type. Site: --t-ink light / --t-bg dark (boundary-globals.css L12, L27), --ink light (baml-globals.css L87).

white.$description: Book p.3: black and white form the base of both brands. Site: --t-bg light (boundary-globals.css L9), --ground light (baml-globals.css L81).

logoBlack.$description: Pure black, the ink the marks are drawn in. Measured off the book's logo pages p.11/15/19/23 and matching the master SVG src-logos/boundary-site/boundary-logo-final.svg. Distinct from color.black (#0F0F0F), which is the type black.

colorCombination.$description: The only approved text-on-color pairings. Brand book p.5 (Color Combinations). Contrast recomputed to WCAG 2.2 relative luminance. Any pairing not listed is unapproved.

boundaryOnWhite.$description: Book p.5, Boundary 1. White card with a Pasture 600 hairline rule. Heading 6.27:1, body 19.17:1.

boundaryOnPasture.$description: Book p.5, Boundary 2. Heading and body 6.27:1 (WCAG AA).

boundaryOnPastureTint.$description: Book p.5, Boundary 3. Heading and body 16.48:1.

bamlOnWhite.$description: Book p.5, BAML 1. White card with a Clover 600 hairline rule. Heading 8.17:1, body 19.17:1.

bamlOnClover800.$description: Book p.5, BAML 2. Heading and body 13.99:1.

display.$description: Lexend, the headline face. Book p.7. Fallback stack from --font-display, boundary-globals.css L82 and baml-globals.css L182. OFL: link from Google Fonts or self-host.

body.$description: Geist, the body face. Book p.7. Fallback stack from --font-sans, boundary-globals.css L80 and baml-globals.css L181. Self-host (Vercel `geist` package); both sites load it with next/font/local.

pixel.$description: Geist Pixel Square, the accent face shared by both brands. Book p.7. Fallback stack from --font-pixel, boundary-globals.css L85; loaded as GeistPixel-Square.otf in src-css/boundary-layout.tsx L37-41. The BAML site does not load it.

weight.$description: Only the weights the book's specimens show. Lexend p.7: Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, ExtraBold. Geist p.7: Light, Regular, SemiBold, Bold, ExtraBold (no Medium shown). Geist Pixel p.7: one style, Square.

medium.$description: Lexend only in the book's specimen. The Boundary site redefines --font-weight-medium as 490 for optical reasons (boundary-globals.css L84); that is a site tuning, not a brand value.

type.$description: The five-level hierarchy. Roles from book p.8, exact values from book p.9 (Anatomy of type). Letter spacing is given in the book as a percentage and converted to em. There is no mobile or responsive scale in the book.

h1.$description: Lexend SemiBold 80px, line height 110%, letter spacing -3%. Primary page headings and hero moments. Book p.8-9.

h2.$description: Lexend Medium 60px, line height 110%, letter spacing -2%. Section headings; switch to Geist Pixel Square for callout moments or headings about BAML. Book p.8-9. Both sites ship a different H2.

h3.$description: Lexend Medium 40px, line height 120%, letter spacing -3%. Supporting headings inside a section. Book p.8-9.

body.$description: Geist Regular 20px, line height 140%, letter spacing 0%. Long-form and UI copy. Book p.8-9.

caption.$description: Geist Pixel Square 16px, line height 110%, letter spacing -2%. Small labels, annotations and highlighted words, across both brands. Book p.8-9. Geist Pixel has one style, so the weight is its single default (400).

logo.$description: Five marks across two brands. Book p.31 (Logo Suite). Aspect ratios are read from each master SVG's viewBox, never assumed.

clearspace.$description: Minimum clearspace on all sides, as a multiple of x, where x is the width of the logomark (for the combination mark, the width of the mark itself). Nothing enters that space. Book p.13, p.17, p.21, p.25, p.29.

minSize.$description: Minimum sizes are measured by HEIGHT. A width-based rule produces an illegally small logo on a wide lockup. Book p.13, p.17, p.21, p.25, p.29.

screen.$description: Boundary primary logo, Boundary logomark, BAML primary logo, BAML logomark. Book p.13/17/21/25.

print.$description: As above, in print. Book p.13/17/21/25.
Combination mark only, in print. Book p.29.

aspectRatio.$description: Width divided by height, from each master SVG's viewBox.

boundaryLogomark.$description: viewBox 0 0 137 86. Gate, isolated from boundary-logo-final.svg. logo/svg/boundary-logomark-black.svg.

siteTheme.$description: SITE-ONLY VALUES — not brand book colors. The surface, ink and rule grays each live site already ships. Recorded so new work matches the sites. The book's values above win in any conflict.

logo.$description: --t-logo, L23. Placeholder customer-logo gray, not a brand color.

baml.$description: src-css/baml-globals.css. Dark is the site default, L37-73; light L115-148.

ground.$description: --ground, L41. Darker than the book's black (#0F0F0F).

muted.$description: --muted, L50. Tuned to clear 4.5:1 against ground and raised (comment L33-35).

raised.$description: --raised, L119. A violet-tinted surface, not a Clover scale step.

head.$description: --head, L123. Pure black, not the book's #0F0F0F.

footer.$description: --footer, L137. Not a Clover scale step.

periwinkle.$description: --color-periwinkle, baml-globals.css L179. Used on the surfaces that stay dark in both themes. Not in the brand book.
